title: Global LLM Official Pricing, Benchmarks and Performance Schema
description: Standardized schema tracking official API token rates, prompt caching, batch discounts, context windows, Artificial Analysis benchmarks, and throughput/latency metrics for leading foundational LLM providers.

models.notes: Flagship multimodal model for complex multimodal reasoning. 50% discount on cached prompt inputs (>1,024 tokens) and 50% discount on Batch API.
Cost-efficient lightweight flagship model replacing GPT-3.5 Turbo. Automatic 50% cache discount and 50% batch discount.
High-depth reasoning model using chain-of-thought tokens (billed as output tokens). Supports 200k context window and 100k completion tokens.
High-speed reasoning model specialized for STEM, mathematics, and complex coding at competitive pricing.
Industry-leading coding and agentic performance. Prompt caching hits receive a 90% discount ($0.30/1M); initial cache writes incur 1.25x ($3.75/1M). Message Batches API grants 50% discount.
High-velocity low-latency model. Prompt caching hit receives 90% discount ($0.08/1M); cache write at $1.00/1M. Message Batches API offers 50% off.
Open-weights reasoning model with emergent reasoning capabilities. Reasoning tokens output rate is $2.19/1M. Automatic prefix caching yields ~74.5% input discount.

General-purpose MoE model (671B total, 37B active). Automatic server-side context caching offers ~74.1% savings on cached hits. No async batch endpoint, but offers off-peak nighttime discounts (00:30-08:30 UTC+8) of 50%.
Powered by Groq LPUs delivering ultra-high token throughput (>300 tokens/sec). Prompt caching and batch processing provide 50% discount tiers.
Sparse MoE architecture hosted on Groq LPU with extremely low latency. Symmetric $0.24/1M pricing. Legacy endpoint transitioning to Llama 3.x series.

Massive 2M token context window for complex multimodal reasoning. Standard tier (<=128k prompt tokens): $1.25 input / $5.00 output; cached input discount is 75% ($0.3125/1M, with $4.50/1M/hr storage fee). Batch API provides 50% discount.

High-speed high-throughput model with 1M context window. Standard tier (<=128k prompt tokens): $0.075 input / $0.30 output; cached input discount is 75% ($0.01875/1M, with $1.00/1M/hr storage fee). Batch API provides 50% discount.
